items.title: Awesome Elm
items.content_text:
### Inspired by Elm / Games

*   [Flame (⭐310)](https://github.com/easafe/purescript-flame) - A library that provides The Elm Architecture in PureScript.
*   [Hyperapp (⭐19k)](https://github.com/jorgebucaran/hyperapp) - A library that provide The Elm Architecture in JavaScript.
*   [Indigo](https://indigoengine.io/) - Indigo is an Elm-inspired game engine for Scala.js.
*   [Lustre (⭐1.8k)](https://github.com/lustre-labs/lustre) - A library that provides The Elm Architecture in Gleam.
*   [Miso (⭐2.3k)](https://github.com/dmjio/miso) - A library that provides The Elm Architecture in Haskell.
*   [Mobius (⭐1.3k)](https://github.com/spotify/mobius) - Elm-like abstractions for android apps, created by Spotify.
*   [React-tea-cup (⭐26)](https://github.com/vankeisb/react-tea-cup) - A thin library that provides The Elm Architecture in react, used by IBM.
*   [Roc (⭐5.2k)](https://github.com/roc-lang/roc) - A language that targets WebAssembly and machine code inspired by Elm.
*   [Sauron (⭐2k)](https://github.com/ivanceras/sauron) - A library that provides The Elm Architecture in Rust targeting the web.
items.content_html:
